corrected_fields.market_structure_context: This guide is directly relevant to the pricing of UK bank capital instruments. It clarifies that in a transfer resolution, shareholders and holders of regulatory capital instruments (AT1, Tier 2, and other non-excluded liabilities) may be subject to losses. The inclusion of historical precedents (Dunfermline 2009, SVBUK 2023) and the description of the Bank Resolution (Recapitalisation) Act 2025 recapitalisation payment mechanism informs how investors should model resolution risk in UK bank securities. Participants holding AT1 or Tier 2 instruments in UK banks near resolution thresholds should treat this as reference material for loss-at-resolution scenarios.
